rules.name: Fix grammar
rules.instruction: Correct spelling, grammar, and punctuation. Preserve meaning and voice.

rules.name: Make specific
rules.instruction: Replace vague phrases with concrete wording. Preserve the facts and constraints.

rules.name: Clarify
rules.instruction: Make the wording clearer while preserving meaning and details.

rules.name: Shorten
rules.instruction: Make the text concise. Keep all essential conditions.

rules.name: Structure
rules.instruction: Organize the text into logical sections and order its requirements.
